# RX Tracker NEXT 4.0.0-next.67

## Added

- Backoffice RX Profile Sync now groups displayed rows by patient. Each group
  shows the total active RX-record count; multi-RX patients are clearly marked
  to review historical records before selecting records to synchronize.

## Safety

- No record changes occur during scanning. Synchronization remains manual,
  audited, and limited to 100 selected RX records per batch. No migration or
  business-data change is included.
